typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		Contact_Id as string,
		Campaign_Id as string,
		Type as string,
		Status as string,
		Disposition as string,
		FILE_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/ib_kpma_campaign_member*']) ~> source1
ConditionalSplit1@Upsert derive(Type = "Contact",
		Status = "Sent") ~> DerivedColumn1
DerivedColumn1 select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		ContactId = Contact_Id,
		CampaignId = Campaign_Id
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select1
source1 derive(ADFId__c = uuid()) ~> addADFId1
addADFId1 split(isNull(Contact_Id)||isNull(Campaign_Id),
	disjoint: false) ~> ConditionalSplit1@(Reject, Upsert)
ConditionalSplit1@Reject derive(REJECT_REASON = concat('ADF:Required Field Contains NULL Value: ', iif(isNull(Contact_Id), 'Contact_Id', ''), iif(isNull(Campaign_Id), 'Campaign_Id', ''), '')) ~> rejectReason
rejectReason select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		REJECT_REASON
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select2
Select1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_kpma_campaign_member_CampaignMember.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> insertcampaignmember
addADFId1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_kpma_campaign_member_raw.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> curatedRaw
Select2 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_kpma_campaign_member_reject.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> toReject
